【原视频简介】
PLAY THE GAME ⭐: 
https://www.roblox.com/games/78906059644178/Satisfying-Slices

Join the Discord: 👀
https://discord.gg/vcapm7akaZ

Building a Roblox game development project focused on satisfying visuals and audio. See how I crafted the core slicing loop.

Making satisfying games requires a tight loop. I started this project by refining the sensation of slicing objects with a knife, ensuring every interaction feels rewarding. This process involved extensive Roblox coding to perfect the feedback loop and sound design.

The progression system centers on earning in-game currency, which players spend on upgrades to enhance their slicing abilities. I walk through the technical challenges of implementing these game mechanics and the balancing required to keep the gameplay loop engaging for Roblox game development.

Whether you are interested in Roblox scripting or just curious about how to make a game feel polished, this breakdown shows exactly how I approached the design process.

Subscribe for weekly game development breakdowns, and let me know in the comments if you want to see the finished release.
